review.notes: Full review. Adversarial pass over all 45 theorems and 15 definitions with computed instances; the first conjunct of 3.7 refuted in Lean at the pins on [0,1] in R (Mathlib's tangentConeAt is two-sided). Seeded sample: 14 locators into Boyd-Vandenberghe and Rockafellar-Wets read at the text (author-hosted copies) and agree; the seven other books (Bauschke-Combettes, Borwein-Lewis, Borwein-Vanderwerff, Hiriart-Urruty-Lemarechal I and II, Schneider, Simon) had no legal copy and are listed as not verifiable. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes no theorem; dependency check reports 0 problems; no change outside the folder. Duplication audit found Minkowski-Weyl for cones on main (ScatteringDiagrams 1.1) and a second definition of essential smoothness in the open LargeDeviations roadmap. Two automatic form checks flagged (a pull-request number in the README, a heading over #check lines), both real, reported as format notes.
